I love this game, but the updates are making it worse.

They scrapped all the old, fun islands. The new ones aren't nearly as interesting, and it feels like there's fewer of them. Almost all the old maps had some big gimmick or core layout variation, and the theming made each biome much more unique. The new ones all just feel like simple arenas. The visibility of what was going on in the distance used to be way better, and the maps actually had more distance. The new "out of bounds" teleportation is an awful idea, and wouldn't be necessary if the islands were designed like the old ones.
The general visual style is quite a bit different, and it doesn't run as well. Some of the new enemies are pretty good, but they did some kind of rebalancing that makes the waves feel less satisfying, describing how would be too much test for this review. Plus, the jumping enemies sometimes cancel-out jumping melee. The new lobby island is claustrophobic, and they removed the parkour course; it was fun to absent-mindedly run through that when waiting on friends. Some of the new pickups are interesting, but they did something to the balancing that's making it stupidly easy to get incredibly overpowered builds.

They removed PVP deathmatch (or I can't find it anywhere). Why???

I'm happy these devs are continuing to work on it, and I'm excited for 1.0, but PLEASE roll back some changes. And focus on extending the challenge over anything else. I don't think it needed a visual overhaul, at all, and while more pickups and enemies would be nice, the biggest issue the game has always had is that it doesn't take that long to become unstoppable, and the infinite loops become trivial and boring. It doesn't take long to unlock every weapon, ability and melee. The biggest balancing change honestly should be to make the game a little harder and give you less upgrades, giving a real challenge for longer and making choices & skill matter more. That would give the game way more substance than just adding more stuff, but they're removing islands, modes, and making the waves feel so more same-y.
reviews.developer_response:
Thanks for the review! Honestly agreed on all of your points, working to add a lot more of the old island designs back as remastered islands as a lot of the current ones are indeed bland and a bit bare without a lot of identity.

The out of bounds mechanic just allows me to design islands that aren't limited to an invisible square wall in terms of their shape but it does take some time to get used to.

Lobby will be improved with a parkour course returning- working on a lot of parkour related stuff now!

Regarding balancing, a lot of changes have been made over the last few months- you can check these out on the beta branch if you want: right click the game in Steam and go to Properties->Game Versions & Betas to try it out!

Regarding PvP: I will paste in my explanation from the previous update patch notes
"As part of my big cleanup of the game assets and code I have removed the Duel minigame for many reasons: it had essentially zero player engagement / interest (understandable as it was barebones to begin with), there are no servers or anti cheat to support matching against random players (the main reason to play PvP) and it has cluttered the code / lowered performance even when not playing it due to how the game is set up. I had explored options to expand it such as supporting more weapons but the game simply just isn’t built for fun PvP- players move too fast and hitboxes are too small to make any weapon other than the rocket launcher viable. Changing movement speeds and creating special weapons with large hitboxes just felt like a janky workaround rather than a fun layer that complimented the main game mode and speeds that players are used to. It feels like a growing trend in gaming lately where games are adding lots of different modes from different genres trying to be “something for everyone” and I want to do the opposite and put all my efforts into making a really good main mode (since that is what people are actually playing) without trying to cater to both PvE and PvP and doing a poor job. All that said, I’ll be adding an endless parkour minigame (the systems there will be used to create unique parkour islands in the main mode) as well as a target practice minigame to round out the total number of minigames to 4 in future updates as both of those fit the actual core game loop a lot better and don’t rely on inviting others to your lobby to play"

Regarding challenge: alongside the beta balance I also added a bunch of hard flex difficulty mods (accessible through the difficulty totem) that really allow you to crank up the challenge if you wish. These will give even very experienced players a true challenge. I do want to get the core Prismatic difficulty level into a satisfying spot though as I do agree it gets boring if you can trivially get infinites every run.

Thanks for the honest and detailed review, it really helps make sure I'm focusing on the right things. Rest assured I am working on improving things and will get the game into a fun and balanced place for 1.0 🦀

reviews.review: Game is awesome. Period. The 2 minigames need to be nerfed a bit, and the multiplayer needs revisited, as my buddy has to click all over the place just to get in after my invite. It should be, invite to game, he gets IN GAME pop-up, boom, he's in game. Anyways, I got the prismatic skin, that's all I really wanted. I'm missing the 2 flawless achievements and the 2 minigame achievements. They're not worth the time or anger. So I guess I'm pretty much done with this game outside of the occasional screw-around with my friend when he wants to play. Some more content would be awesome, but I'm pretty sure the dev's wife just had a baby, so I'm not expecting ANYTHING new in 2026 at this point, lol! Cheers, go buy this game.
